prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the current Kraken boss. Keep its recognizable jagged tall mantle, narrow sinister crimson eyes, heavy arms, bold slightly irregular iron-gall outlines, flat cream/tan fills, extremely sparse hatch marks, and transparent background.

Make TWO focused corrections:
1. Turn the entire creature into a strongly LEFT-FACING three-quarter/profile attacking pose. The Kraken lives on the RIGHT side of the game screen and its opponent is at the LEFT edge. Its face, gaze and two main reaching arms must unmistakably point toward LEFT, never toward the viewer or right. Place the massive jagged mantle mostly in the upper-right portion of the creature, tilted forward toward LEFT. Show one dominant narrow crimson eye on its visible LEFT-facing side, and at most a small partially hidden far eye. Retain the sharp eye shape and jagged top that identify this boss. Foreground arms reach outward into the LEFT half of the canvas; rear coils trail below and to the RIGHT. Do not merely mirror the original frontal pose.
2. Clean up the head-to-arms anatomy. Create a short, broad, smooth cream neck/arm-collar clearly BELOW the eye level. All eight major arms grow from distinct, readable roots on the LOWER edge of that collar. Use simple continuous arm outlines with no more than two overlaps at one junction. The eyes remain embedded in the mantle ABOVE the collar, clearly separated from the arm roots. Remove the weird feather-like spikes, slashed black tangles, dangling black central shape and exposed bird-like beak beneath the eyes. No arms growing from eye sockets, cheeks, or brow. No extra little flaps or pointed tissue around the eyes. If the mouth exists, it is hidden under the arms.

Maintain a threatening, heavy silhouette and a simple old sea-map drawing: broad empty cream forms, muted tan underside bands, a few large sucker ovals on the leading arms. Keep almost the same low detail as the target. Do not add skin texture, dense hatching, gradients, glow, dramatic lighting, teeth, horns, feathers, eyelash shapes, modern cartoon expression, ornament, or additional objects.
Framing: whole creature visible with 8–10% genuinely transparent margins on every side; all arm tips inside frame; a few simple ink wave marks below are fine. No ship, paper rectangle, background, text, frame or checkerboard.
invariants: Keep jagged mantle, narrow crimson eyes, simple ink/cream/tan art direction, transparent PNG and larger boss scale.
changes: Left-facing three-quarter attacking pose, smooth arm collar below the eyes, distinct arm roots; remove beak-like centre and tangles around the eyes.
enemy_direction: Enemy faces and attacking poses should point left toward the player ship.
